item.title: Ex-CCM singer Stacie Orrico sues former manager for alleged sexual assault, exploitation
item.description: Former Christian music pop star Stacie Orrico has filed a civil lawsuit accusing her former manager of grooming, sexually assaulting, and exploiting her as a minor. #CCM #StacieOrrico #Lawsuit

item.title: Abortion is leading cause of death worldwide 7th consecutive year
item.description: Abortion remains the leading cause of death worldwide for the seventh year in a row, according to statistics compiled by Worldometer. #Abortion #Worldometer #WorldHealthOrganization

item.title: Pastor, former college basketball player gets 30 months for PPP loan, tax fraud
item.description: Ricky Lee Taylor, a former University of Tennessee at Chattanooga basketball player turned pastor and businessman, has been sentenced to 30 months in prison and three years of probation after pleading guilty to wire and tax fraud connected to his abuse of the federal government’s Paycheck Protection Program during the COVID-19 pandemic. #RickyLeeTaylor #Pastor #ArenaofPraise #PPPLoan #Fraud #Tax

item.title: Man violently disrupts NYC church service, storms altar, gets tased by police
item.description: Police have tased a man who violently disrupted a church service in New York, with the individual storming the altar before authorities subdued him. #CatholicChurch #StatenIsland #NewYorkCity #church #altar #crime #police

item.title: Chris Tomlin releases ‘Jesus Saves’ EP after chart-topping album, year of spiritual milestones
item.description: After one of the most successful and expansive years of his career, including leading worship at Charlie Kirk’s memorial service, Grammy Award-winning worship leader Chris Tomlin is opening 2026 with new music, releasing the "Jesus Saves" EP. #ChrisTomlin #CharlieKirk #JesusSaves #music #worshipmusic

item.title: Mass. women's prison 'a haven for sexual predators who pretend to be transgender': report
item.description: An advocate for reform in women’s prisons is calling for an overhaul of federal law following a recent report highlighting serious allegations of harassment and sexual assault at a Massachusetts women’s correctional facility. #Prison #Reform #WomensAdvocacy #Transgender #MCIFramingham

item.title: Biblical nutritionist Annette Reeder on God, gummy bears and good health
item.description: With more than 20 million YouTube views to her credit, Annette Reeder wants to see the strongholds of food and substance addiction eradicated. #Biblicalnutritionist #AnnetteReeder #health #gummybears #diet

item.title: Hillsong Church says property plans aren’t final after reports of multi-million-dollar development
item.description: Hillsong Church has confirmed it is in talks with “experienced development partners” about plans to develop its sprawling Hills Campus for the "long-term mission of the church and the benefit of the wider community," but nothing is final. #HillsongChurch #HillsCampus #Australia #NSW #Development #Evangelical #Megachurch

item.title: ‘Blessings in No Time’ couple convicted by grand jury of defrauding investors in pyramid scheme
item.description: A federal jury in Texas has convicted LaShonda and Marlon Moore, the couple behind “Blessings in No Time,” for running a multi-million-dollar pyramid scheme during the COVID-19 pandemic. #Texas #LaShondaandMarlonMoore #BlessingsinNoTimeScheme #PyramidScheme #Fraud #COVID19Pandemic #IllegalInvestment #AfricanAmerican

item.title: Franklin Graham says ICE protesters are 'underpinned by the radical socialist left'
item.description: The Rev. Franklin Graham accused demonstrators protesting U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, following the death of Renee Good in Minneapolis, of being "underpinned" by radical socialist forces. #ReneeGood #FranklinGraham #ICEMinneapolis #Venezuela
